text:
tara: ptal — addressed the requested changes on PR #4678. moved validator out of `service/` into `pkg/validation`, added two unit tests and a small compatibility shim. i left one TODO with a comment. aiming to merge before tomorrow's canary slot if no objections.

mike: taking a look now, thanks.

olivia: quick question: did you keep the old config key mapping? i remember that bit caused issues last time.

tara: good call — kept a short migration in `migrations/0003_validator_key.go` and added a note in the PR description. also ran `make test-unit` locally — all green.

ci-bot: CI status: build passed — unit tests 132/132, lint OK. (https://ci.internal/build/9821) :white_check_mark:

mike: skimmed the change. small nit: rename `ValidateX` -> `ValidateReq` to match naming elsewhere. other than that LGTM.

tara: thanks — pushed rename and force-pushed the branch (`git push -f origin pr/4678/refactor`).

mike: lgtm. i can be merge owner for the 10:30 PT canary window tomorrow. assigning myself.

olivia: fine by me. left one tiny inline suggestion about an error message but not blocking.

tara: fixed that message and added a one-line note in the changelog. thanks both.

mike: great. i'll take merge + monitor the canary. if anything spikes i'll rollback and ping this thread.

tara: perfect — thanks @mike :rocket:

olivia: thanks — feel free to @me if you want a quick sanity check post-canary.

ci-bot: Deploy plan: canary -> 10% for 15m -> promote if no errors. Will post metrics link on deploy.
